title: PrepLadder · 26.Voice Pathologies and Congenital Lesions of Larynx

questions.topic: PrepLadder · 26.Voice Pathologies and Congenital Lesions of Larynx
questions.stem: A 16-year-old boy presents with a voice that sounds similar to that of a female, characterized by a high-pitched voice despite the completion of puberty. What could be a potential underlying cause related to the vocal cords for this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Immature growth of vocal cords leading to lengthening of vocal cords

options.label: B
options.text: Immature growth of vocal cords leading to relative shortening of vocal cords

options.label: C
options.text: Immature growth of vocal cords leading to incomplete closure of the anterior part of vocal cords

options.label: D
options.text: Immature growth of vocal cords leading to excessive thickening of vocal cords
